Class GroundTruthStatisticsKernel

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.GroundTruthStatisticsKernel
public final class GroundTruthStatisticsKernel extends Object
Epistemic Statistics Kernel for Ground Truth Audits. Evaluates Cohen's d effect sizes, Pearson correlation coefficients, Theil inequality decompositions (U^M bias, U^S variance, U^C covariance), and temporal error patterns.
Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
